newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Cricket-Irish set target of 202 runs vs Glamorgan.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Irish set target of 202 runs vs Glamorgan.

text.p: Ireland finished with a total of 202 runs for nine wickets at the end of their limited overs against Glamorgan in the Benson and Hedges Cup on Tuesday.
South African Test captain Hansie Cronje was Ireland's top scorer with 85 runs.
The Irish, who have already beaten Middlesex but lost to Sommerset in the Cup this season, were on 74 runs for three wickets after 20.5 overs when rain stopped play on Monday.
